description: Kendall-readout tied unembedder. residual LUTs -> E=64 (predicted embedding e_hat, 6x smaller residual_lut); logit(v)=approx-Kendall-tau(e_hat, emb_v) over K=E*log2E=384 coord pairs = popcount of partial-order codes, codes TIED to tok_emb_E (no separate output params). matmul-free popcount at deploy, ~32x less head bandwidth than Linear, smaller backbone. The embedder IS the unembedder via rank-similarity. vs exp513 Linear 1.4825/1.4656.
